_comment: Firstmate's command allow-list starter for Claude Code.
WHY THIS IS TRACKED. The commands a firstmate worker runs are a property of
this repository's toolchain, not of anybody's laptop: every home runs the
same validation pipeline, the same forge wrapper, the same backlog and quota
tools, and the same helper scripts out of bin/. Without these rules a home
running the prompting permission posture asks its operator to approve
'no-mistakes axi run' once per worker, per invocation, forever. Shipping the
list is what makes the workflow reproducible from a clone.
DERIVED FROM, not copied from a configured machine: bin/fm-bootstrap.sh's own
COMMON_TOOLS essential set and its per-backend tool resolution, the lint
tools bin/fm-lint.sh and bin/fm-lint-workflows.sh refuse to run without, and
the helper scripts every generated brief tells a worker to run.
{{FM_ROOT}} is substituted with this home's own firstmate checkout when
bootstrap merges the file, so no machine's absolute path is ever committed.
DELIBERATELY NOT HERE, and each omission is a decision rather than an
oversight:
- bash, sh, zsh, python3, node: pre-approving an interpreter pre-approves
every command it can be handed, which would silently restore the bypass
posture this list exists to make unnecessary.
- git commit, push, checkout, branch, reset, rebase, merge: these change
repository state. Only read-only git is pre-approved below, and note that
'git branch' is absent because the same prefix carries 'git branch -D'.
- npm and other installers: a worker must not install packages unasked.
- tmux, herdr, zellij, orca, cmux: workers reach the runtime through
firstmate's own bin/ scripts, which are covered by the bin rule below.
Add any of these yourself if your home wants them; bootstrap never removes a
rule and never narrows one you already have.
